title: Syntomic local kernel generators retaining their fibre codimension count
statement: Let R,S be commutative rings, S an R-algebra, q∈Spec S, n a natural number, and φ:R[x_1,...,x_n]→S a surjective R-algebra map with finitely generated kernel I. Assume R_{q∩R}→S_q is flat and the canonical fibre prime of S has a principal global-complete-intersection neighbourhood over κ(q∩R). Then there are c≤n and f:Fin c→R[x_1,...,x_n] such that (f)≤I, the extensions of (f) and I to the polynomial local ring at φ⁻¹(q) agree, and the local topological dimension at the canonical fibre prime of S is n-c.

proof.text: Construct the canonical polynomial fibre comparison, reusing polynomial_fiber_equiv_quotient, polynomial_fiber_equiv_quotient_tmul and completeIntersection_of_algEquiv from SyntomicPolynomialFibreComparison through a proof-only import all. Keep t as the image of the specified fibre prime under this concrete equivalence, rather than taking an arbitrary witness of the public existential comparison. The natural fibre local-ring isomorphism and polynomial scalar-extension formula construct e:A/pA ≃ k[x]_{Qbar}, preserving the mapped kernel ideal. This is the existing comparison construction, with its prime retained explicitly.

Let H be the homeomorphism of spectra induced by the concrete fibre quotient equivalence. The chosen quotient prime is H(qb). For each open neighbourhood U of qb, its inverse image under H.symm is an open neighbourhood of H(qb), homeomorphic to U by restriction of H.symm. Invariance of topological Krull dimension under this restricted homeomorphism and the infimum definition of dimension at a point give dimAt(H(qb)) ≤ dimAt(qb). Applying the same argument to H gives the reverse inequality. These two infimum inequalities are proved directly in the comparison helper, without importing the smooth-differentials module.

The complete-intersection conormal rank theorem gives d ≤ n and a basis of size n-d. Apply the localized ideal generator bound to this basis, using Noetherianity of the polynomial ring over the residue field to supply finite generation of Ibar. Thus the fibre ideal L has spanFinrank ≤ n-d. Transport its finite generation and spanFinrank through e to K, the image of IA in A/pA.

Reuse the completely proved private lift_generators_from_localized_quotient helper of SyntomicFibreKernelGenerators, through a proof-only import all. It chooses c=spanFinrank K original elements f_i in I, clears their localization denominators by units, and proves IA ≤ JA+pA. Its finite-generation input is the transported fibre ideal, so no Noetherian hypothesis on the original base is introduced.

Since c ≤ n-d, extend f to g:Fin(n-d)→P by setting g_i=f_i for i<c and g_i=0 otherwise. The two ideal spans are equal: every new entry is either an old entry or zero, and every old entry is attained by its index in the larger Fin type. Therefore g lies in I and retains the generation-modulo-pA assertion.

Write m=pA. The flat local-kernel intersection theorem gives IA∩m=m IA. Since JA≤IA, decomposing x in IA as y+z with y in JA and z in m shows z=x-y lies in IA∩m. Hence IA≤JA+m IA. The algebra-map compatibility shows m lies in the maximal ideal of A. Apply Mathlib Submodule.le_of_le_smul_of_le_jacobson_bot to the finite ideal IA and JA, with m≤jacobson(0), to obtain IA≤JA. Together with JA≤IA this proves equality of the localized ideals.

Set the final equation count to n-d. Then n-d≤n, and d≤n gives n-(n-d)=d. Compose the comparison dimension equality with the conormal theorem dimension equality. All arguments include d=n, c=0, zero original kernel, and zero variables; the specified fibre prime excludes an empty fibre.

theorem exists_codimension_local_kernel_generators
    {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    (q : PrimeSpectrum S) (n : ℕ) (φ : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R →ₐ[R] S)
    (hφ : Function.Surjective φ) (hfg : (RingHom.ker φ.toRingHom).FG)
    (hflat : (Localization.localRingHom (q.asIdeal.comap (algebraMap R S)) q.asIdeal
      (algebraMap R S) rfl).Flat)
    (hci : ∃ h : (q.asIdeal.comap (algebraMap R S)).Fiber S,
      h ∉ (PrimeSpectrum.preimageEquivFiber R S (q.comap (algebraMap R S))
        ⟨q, rfl⟩).asIdeal ∧
      IsGlobalCompleteIntersection (q.asIdeal.comap (algebraMap R S)).ResidueField
        (Localization.Away h)) :
    ∃ (c : ℕ) (f : Fin c → MvPolynomial (Fin n) R),
      c ≤ n ∧ Ideal.span (Set.range f) ≤ RingHom.ker φ.toRingHom ∧
      Ideal.map (algebraMap _
        (Localization.AtPrime (q.asIdeal.comap φ.toRingHom))) (Ideal.span (Set.range f)) =
      Ideal.map (algebraMap _
        (Localization.AtPrime (q.asIdeal.comap φ.toRingHom))) (RingHom.ker φ.toRingHom) ∧
      topologicalKrullDimAt
        (PrimeSpectrum.preimageEquivFiber R S (q.comap (algebraMap R S)) ⟨q, rfl⟩) =
          (n - c : ℕ)
